5.7 Summary of Results 
The conducted investigation looked into the effectiveness of a gamified, short-
form content delivery system, the proposed application has demonstrated 
significant promise to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes 
among GCSE students. The comparative analysis against the more traditional 
learning methods within Bitesize, revealed that while both platforms exhibited 
lesson lengths within the optimal time range, the proposed application 
significantly reduced variability for learning times. The integration of gamified 
elements such as immediate performance contingent rewards, and short-form 
content delivery, likely contributed towards these results.  
The proposed application exhibited higher distractibility levels when compared to 
Bitesize, despite this students using the proposed application achieved superior 
exam scores. This seems to suggest that the gamified elements and or the 
short-form content delivery system, where possibly more distracting. While 
contradicting evidence, points towards the application being more engaging and 
effective. The finding of this investigation highlights the complexities for 
increasing student focus and engagement through the use of an interactive 
learning system. 
Overall, the findings validate the hypothesis that gamified short-form content in 
an education setting can significantly enhance student engagement, retention 
and content mastery.
